title: Is Even
description: Write a function that returns true if a number is even and false if it is odd. An even number is divisible by 2 with no remainder. For example, 2, 4, 6, and 0 are even numbers.
instructions: Complete the is_even function so it returns true for even numbers and false for odd numbers.
expected_behavior: is_even(2) -> true, is_even(3) -> false, is_even(0) -> true, is_even(-4) -> true, is_even(7) -> false
hints: A number is even if it has no remainder when divided by 2.
Use the modulo operator %: n % 2 gives you the remainder when dividing n by 2.
If n % 2 == 0, the number is even.
